instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F with a rack on the bottom shelf. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Put the riced cauliflower in a microwave-safe bowl, cover it, and microwave on high for 5 minutes. Let it cool for 10 minutes.
Transfer the cauliflower to a clean kitchen towel. Gather the towel and twist it over the sink, squeezing out as much liquid as you can.
Put the cauliflower in a large bowl with the egg, 3/4 cup of the mozzarella, the Parmesan, 1 crushed garlic clove, the oregano, salt and pepper. Stir until it comes together in a soft dough.
Transfer the dough to the parchment. Press it with your hands into a 12-inch circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the pizza sauce over the crust. Sprinkle on the other 3/4 cup of mozzarella.
Bake on the bottom shelf for 20 to 25 minutes, until the cheese is golden in spots.
Let it cool for 5 minutes, then cut it into 8 slices. The crust stays soft, so serve it with a knife and fork.
method_notes: Bigger Bolder Baking leads (4.82 from 32 ratings): cooked, well-squeezed riced cauliflower bound with an egg, mozzarella and Parmesan, pressed to 12 inches and baked topped at 425°F. Its recipe takes 35 minutes of prep and uses a food processor to rice a whole head, so this uses a pound of ready-riced cauliflower and a 10 minute cool to keep the total near 45 minutes. The page links its 5 minute pizza sauce but doesn't print it, so a jar of pizza sauce goes here. Use Parmesan without animal rennet to keep it vegetarian. The bake time is the lead's.
